featured_reviews.name: Laxman Katta
featured_reviews.review_text:
ONE OF THE WORST AND MOST FORGING PRODUCTION HOUSE WITH OVERHYPED ADVOCATE!!

We had to print T-Shirts for our company with our LOGO and TAGLINE on front to back. We approached the garment house for the selection, We have been introduced to the samples with two categories of price tags that one is HIGH range and the other is LOW range by the owner himself.

The guy is robust with gun-point salesmanship, convinced us of HIGH price range carries great quality and most of their brand ambassadors in tennis cricket field wears. Without giving it a thought, We have place the order of 30+ quantities at the HIGH range and we were promised to get a call when the order is ready - and we did not get the call for a week and when we call the guy and the guy scold us back squalling us of being irresponsible for not calling him on order.

When we reach there to collect the product/lot, We got astonished to witness that our products were of very very poor quality that carries very much of dull print. There was pretty much deflection in the color and when we bring that into their notice, the guy refuse to take responsibility and inducing indisposed pretexts by saying "Yeh Aise Hi Hota Hain, 420 Rs Per Piece Mein Aur Kya Chahiye?".

This guy left us with no choice than to take up and get the hell out from there.

Final part: The payment was around Rs 12000/- and we were determined to pay using UPI or Card Swipe. and the guy is not ready to accept any of those. This is 2022, and who accepts CASH of Rs 12000? unless there is any tax evasion.

NOTE: The quality they provide to their ambassador and the quality they provide to the normal people like us very different. irrespective of the quality and quantity, the guy has always been rude to customers and there are many people claiming the same against this guy.

DO NOT BUY FROM SUCH PEOPLE AND IF YOU DO, IT WILL GIVE THEM SUPERBIA TO HUMILIATE THE ORDINARY PEOPLE LIKE US.

featured_reviews.name: Buccaneer2.0
featured_reviews.review_text:
Total Sports & Fitness - A Sporting Wonderland 🏆⚽🎾 (4 Stars) 🌟🌟🌟🌟

Stepping into Total Sports & Fitness feels like entering a sports encyclopedia—there’s literally everything for every sport! Whether you’re a cricketer, footballer, fitness enthusiast, or just someone looking for quality sports gear, this place has got you covered. 🏏🏀🏋️‍♂️

The Dadar outlet is a landmark store that has been around for years, and for many, it’s more than just a shop—it’s a place filled with childhood memories. Generations of sports lovers have walked through these doors, making it an integral part of Mumbai’s sporting culture. 🏟️🏆

A big shoutout to the hardworking backend team who ensure a fantastic customer experience. They know their products well and guide you with expert advice, making sure you get exactly what you need. 🙌👏

While the experience was great, a little more space to browse freely would be a welcome addition. But all in all, if you love sports, Total Sports & Fitness is a must-visit! 💯🔥

featured_reviews.name: Raju Chiluka
featured_reviews.review_text:
I bought a chess board set from this shop on 29-01-2026 as a gift for my friend. When he opened it, we found that one white pawn was missing from the box.
I went back to the shop with a valid bill expecting basic responsibility and customer support. Instead, the owner refused to help and completely denied any compliance. There was no attempt to verify the issue, no apology, and no effort to provide a replacement.
This shows a total lack of professionalism and zero customer-centered service. Selling a product is easy, but standing by it is what defines a genuine business. Unfortunately, this shop clearly does not believe in after-sales support.
Very disappointing experience. I would strongly advise customers to thoroughly check items before leaving the store because once you walk out, they take no responsibility.
Not recommended at all.

featured_reviews.name: Lakshay Khurana
featured_reviews.review_text: Their website is a scam. Do not every buy things off the website.  The product I received was already damaged and they blamed it on me and I ended up wasting 10000₹ after they rejected to replace or return it. It was returned the same day when I recieved it and still got blamed that the paddle was broken due to extensive use while playing pickleball.   I very well know and use many other brand paddles which are absolutely perfect but this paddle and experience both were the worst

featured_reviews.name: mohammad shafaat
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a disappointing experience at this store. I went in to check out slides, but they had only one color option available. When I asked the sales lady to show me my size (UK 7) so I could check the comfort, she dismissively said, “Who checks slides?” This kind of response felt unprofessional and careless.

It came across as if helping customers was an inconvenience, which is surprising from a brand like Nike that’s known worldwide for its customer service. It’s disappointing to see staff unwilling to make a genuine effort, especially when this directly affects sales and the store’s reputation.

I sincerely hope the management takes this feedback seriously and provides proper training in customer service and professionalism, because customers deserve a much better in-store experience from such a reputed brand.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
These guys are amazing.
I had gone here with my 9 year old boy to buy a cricket bat and the salesperson was very patient and explained ya thoroughly what are the different types of bat and how there are dupes in the market at a lower price.
He guided us which one should we take and showed us 8-10 different willow bats .
We chose a Sg Kashmir willow and the owner was very kind and gave us some discount as I requested him to give the best price possible .
Overall amazing store - was thrilled to see them have bats of the older generation . From running , swimming , cricket football, skates and even a real boomerang ... these guys are simply the best in the market

I wish them all the best and continue the great work .

featured_reviews.name: Muneer Toprani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointed and suprised with their way of doing business. They want to have business but don't have any flexibility for doing ethical business.
I gave them a list of sports items which I would have bought from them, first of all Mr. Vaibhav is such a lazy person, needed to be followed up several times to get a proper reply.
I had a sports outfit list that was going to be ordered with them, asked them to quote, Vaibhav took he own sweet time to reply, had to be called and followed up several times.
Then when asked for samples , he asked to pay and we agreed, unknowingly we got very cheap grade of items as samples from them, for which we were charged Rs 4,000/- none of the apparels were good and the price also not at all right or value for money. Did not get an Invoice from them for the Rs. 4,000/-.
When went back to them asking them to adjust the items towards something that is useful and right for our use, Vaibhav refused to do so.
What we got from them is not at all worth Rs. 4000/-.
I went to them knowing their historic presence in the market but sadly I got cheated by them by Mr. Vaibhav.
Ultimately I made a purchase of 245 Sports uniforms from another vendor worth Rs 1,75,000/- and bought other Sports items worth more than Rs 4 Lakhs. Bad luck to then.
